tasks.phase_name: Canonical 开发环境与工程脚手架
tasks.title: Ubuntu 24.04 Canonical Environment Preflight
requirements: 实现/提供 Ubuntu 24.04 LTS 环境检查
非 canonical 环境给出明确失败或 WSL2 指引
记录 toolchain 版本，不允许 Worker 静默 major upgrade
acceptance_criteria: Ubuntu 24.04 clean host/WSL2 可得到确定性检查结果
缺少任一关键工具时错误明确并给出修复动作
Windows Native 被标记为 unsupported canonical environment

tasks.phase_name: Canonical 开发环境与工程脚手架
tasks.title: 验证规格仓库与任务依赖图
requirements: 校验 canonical source repository：origin normalized owner/name 为 lichman0405/post、integration branch 为 main，并在首次 push 前重新读取 visibility
校验 Markdown/spec JSON/YAML 可读取
校验 tasks.json 依赖无缺失/无环
acceptance_criteria: remote/branch/visibility preflight 结果可审计；visibility 与 owner 预期不明确时必须 SPEC_BLOCKED，禁止首次 push

tasks.phase_name: Canonical 开发环境与工程脚手架
tasks.title: 初始化 Go + Next.js + Python Adapter Monorepo
requirements: 初始化 root Go module：cmd/api,worker,mcp-server,rddev 与 internal domain/application/ports/adapters
初始化 apps/web：Next.js Active LTS + React + strict TypeScript + Primer/Octicons
统一 Makefile/format/lint/test/build，不使用 Turborepo 控制 Go/Python
acceptance_criteria: 根目录一条命令完成 Go/Web/Python 基础检查
Go API/Web/Python adapter 均有最小 build/smoke
不存在 TypeScript API backend placeholder
workspace/跨语言契约边界与 docs/65 一致

tasks.phase_name: Canonical 开发环境与工程脚手架

tasks.phase_name: Canonical 开发环境与工程脚手架

tasks.title: Worker 权限隔离与结果收集

collect 校验 HEAD 等于 baseline 且无非法 ref mutation

合法代码修改可正常测试和收集

tasks.title: Enforce append-only / version immutability at the storage layer
tasks.phase_name: Canonical 开发环境、Orchestrator 与工程脚手架
requirements: Add a forward-only migration enforcing immutability on the append-only/version tables.

Owner-decided mechanism: BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers that RAISE EXCEPTION, applied to the version/history tables (at minimum scientific_object_versions, relation_versions, state commits, and the append-only ledger tables such as audit/contribution ledger).
The trigger must reject in-place mutation of a committed version row and reject DELETE, with an error message that names the table/operation.
Preserve every existing constraint; add no new column semantics.
Evidence must be reproduced against a real PostgreSQL, not asserted from reading DDL.
deliverables: integration tests covering the enforced invariant
acceptance_criteria: an UPDATE of an existing scientific_object_versions row is rejected by the database
a DELETE of an existing version row is rejected by the database
legitimate INSERT of a new version row still succeeds
the rejection is proven by SQLSTATE/exception evidence against a real PostgreSQL, and by a regression test
fresh install and upgrade path both apply the migration cleanly
no existing constraint is weakened; migration is forward-only and repeat-migrate safe
ops/doctor.sh and make check still pass; no file outside allowed_scope is modified
